newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Bangladeshi corpse found in airplane in Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi corpse found in airplane in Saudi.

text.p: A Bangladeshi man who had stowed away in the wheel compartment of a commercial aircraft in Dhaka was found dead shortly after arriving in Riyadh after a six-hour flight, a Bangladesh embassy official said on Sunday.

The man, identified only as "Mahboub" and believed to be about 18-years-old, was discovered clutching a rod in the wheel bay of a Bangladesh national airline Biman aircraft which arrived in the Saudi Arabian capital early on Saturday, he said.
"He could have died from suffocation," he said. "We don't know how he got there. The Saudi authorities are investigating."
Officials at Riyadh airport were not immediately available for comment.
